source_review.notes: Checked 16 unique primary Apache Parquet references covering file layout, authoritative format repository, Thrift metadata, physical/logical types, nested levels, nulls, pages, column chunks, encodings, page indexes, Bloom filters, modular encryption, feature/version compatibility, implementation status, and configuration guidance.

evidence: Reviewed file F, schema S, row groups G_i, column chunks C_ij, row intervals I_i, pages, type/encoding/codec parameters, definition/repetition sequences, candidate units, exclusion predicate, projection leaves, and scheduled-byte expression.
Checked quantifiers, half-open row intervals, level maxima, encoded-value cardinality, and distinction between candidates and matching rows.
notation_and_syntax.notes: File, horizontal row interval, leaf column, page, logical row and encoded-value indexes remain distinct.

evidence: Executed parquet-pruning-audit with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced selected groups 2 and 3, 200 candidate of 300 total rows, 800 projected versus 4500 full compressed-byte units, levels (1,0,1,0), encoded values (7,8), and reconstruction (7,None,8,None).
Manually recomputed each range-overlap decision and projected-byte sum from the three row-group metadata records.
Recomputed exercise candidates for bounds [0,9], [10,19], [20,29], [30,39] under (17,31] and value consumption for five definition levels with three physical values.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Synthetic byte units illustrate metadata arithmetic only and are not a real Parquet size benchmark.

evidence: Re-derived row-group alignment as equal reconstruction of interval I_i by every leaf chunk.
Re-derived level bounds and the equality between encoded-value count and maximum-definition occurrences.
Checked conservative exclusion as a universal impossibility claim and candidate-set preservation of every possible match.
Reviewed projected-byte summation over predicate and output leaves while noting page pruning/request coalescing as implementation effects.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Pruning soundness is kept separate from selectivity and performance.

evidence: Reviewed empty/truncated files, bad leading/trailing magic, oversized or overflowing footer lengths, out-of-file/overlapping chunk and page ranges, malformed Thrift collections, inconsistent counts, unsupported pages/encodings, dictionary fallback, truncated compression, expansion, and checksum failure.

Reviewed definition/repetition underflow, overflow and value-count mismatch; null versus empty list/map/element; legacy list structures; decimal extrema/scale; timestamp units/timezones/INT96; NaN, unsigned and truncated byte-array statistics.

Reviewed absent/corrupt page indexes, Bloom false positives and invalid hashes, partial encryption, metadata leakage, missing keys, tiny/giant files/groups/pages, partial publication, prefix-list races, duplicate/gapped compaction, schema drift and old-reader feature support.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Uncertain optimization metadata expands reads; structural corruption fails/quarantines the file instead of silently changing dataset truth.

evidence: Traced byte-range, row-alignment, level-consumption, type-fidelity, conservative-pruning, immutable-publication, resource and security invariants through the sixteen-step lifecycle.
Verified the executable audit consumes values only at maximum definition level and selects every row group whose bounds can overlap the predicate.
Checked compaction and schema migration examples for one-source-snapshot input, stable row identity, duplicate/gap reconciliation, atomic manifest publication and rollback.
invariant_checking.notes: Performance metadata is never allowed to override logical completeness, schema meaning or snapshot atomicity.

evidence: Reviewed datasets A={1,5,10} and B={1,10} with identical exact min/max [1,10] under equality predicate x=5.
Confirmed A contains a match and B does not, so overlapping bounds cannot establish membership.
Checked the valid conclusion that overlap retains a candidate while actual data or another sound structure determines matches.
proof_review.notes: The proof does not deny safe exclusion when trustworthy bounds establish impossibility.

evidence: Confirmed the min/max membership counterexample is explicitly labeled a proof sketch.
Audited uses of valid, safe, exact, immutable, atomic, trustworthy, conservative, compatible, prove and guarantee for stated type, feature, snapshot and threat conditions.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No extension, statistics overlap, Bloom positive, checksum, nominal version or successful parse is promoted to unconditional truth.

evidence: Confirmed parquet-pruning-audit is labeled a synthetic metadata model rather than a real file parser or benchmark.
Reviewed codec, encoding, clustering, file/group/page sizing, projection, pruning, object-store and Arrow comparisons as workload- and implementation-dependent.
Confirmed no universal sizing, compression, speedup, reader support, security certification, production reliability or external-review claim.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Current format and implementation behavior is attributed to directly retrieved Apache sources and still requires deployed-version testing.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed footer-oriented layout, row groups, chunks, pages, types, encoding/compression, nested levels, projection, statistics, indexes, filters, evolution, immutability, compaction, integrity, encryption and Arrow contrast as one coherent storage model.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed byte-bounded sizing, feature inventories, cross-reader fixtures, footer/range validation, safe pruning degradation, object snapshots, compaction reconciliation, key policy, untrusted ingestion limits and production layout telemetry. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from physical file navigation through nested semantics to dataset operations; ten examples and five complete answers cover bounds, level consumption, nullable lists, cloud sizing experiments and atomic decimal migration.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, Apache Parquet, data-practitioner, security, cryptographic, performance, cloud-provider, or production-interoperability review is claimed.
